# Talented Education Group & Victory Scholars Academy

> Talented Education Group (TEG) is an education agency (Sydney, Australia; Pontianak & Singkawang, Indonesia) that helps Indonesian and Southeast Asian students study abroad (Australia, New Zealand, UK, Canada, Singapore, Malaysia, Korea, Japan and more). Victory Scholars Academy (VSA) is TEG's language school: English, IELTS, PTE, Japanese and Korean classes, online and offline in Pontianak and Singkawang.

## Key pages
- [Study cost calculator / price list](https://pricelist.talentededucationgroup.com/): tuition, upfront cost, total cost and suggested bank-statement balance for student visas, 15 languages.
- [Les IELTS & PTE Pontianak & Singkawang (VSA)](https://info.talentededucationgroup.com/les/): class types, locations, FAQ.
- [Free Mock Test IELTS/PTE/HSK/TOPIK/JLPT](https://pricelist.talentededucationgroup.com/?lang=id#mocktest)
- [Book official tests (PTE Academic, IELTS, HSK, TOPIK, JLPT)](https://pricelist.talentededucationgroup.com/?lang=id#book-pte)
- [Scholarships for Indonesian students](https://pricelist.talentededucationgroup.com/?lang=id#scholarships)
- [Blog: visa, study abroad & test tips](https://info.talentededucationgroup.com/blog/)
- [Contact / free consultation](https://linktr.ee/talentededucationgroup)

- Verified agent memberships shown on the website (PIER, QEAC, ESOS Agent Academy, Pearson PTE partner).
- Price list coverage (Nov 2026): 4,100+ Australia & New Zealand programmes at 160+ institutions in 24 cities, plus 2,700+ programmes in 20+ other countries; 15 languages; updated monthly.
- All prices are estimates; final amounts follow the school's offer letter.
